top5.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion
top5.description: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion, at a valuation of $1.25 trillion.
top5.why: OpenAI’s reported $11 billion financing at a $1.25 trillion valuation underscores the extraordinary capital scale and competitive stakes of the AI industry.

top5.title: AMD now defines itself as a data center-focused company
top5.description: CEO Lisa Su says server chips now define AMD, with the data center segment accounting for about 63% of third-quarter 2026 revenue. Quarterly revenue reached $13.4 billion, while gaming sales fell 40%.
top5.why: AMD’s data-center business now drives most of its revenue, confirming that AI infrastructure—not gaming—is reshaping the company’s strategy and market position.

top5.title: Fox finalizes $22 billion acquisition of Roku
top5.description: Fox has completed its $22 billion acquisition of Roku, strengthening its position in streaming and connected TV. The deal gives Fox direct access to more than 100 million households and is expected to improve ad targeting.
top5.why: Fox’s $22 billion acquisition of Roku significantly strengthens its control over connected-TV distribution, household reach, and advertising data.

top5.title: TSMC considers entering AI memory chips at Nvidia’s request
top5.description: TSMC is considering entering the market for AI memory chips at Nvidia’s request.
top5.why: TSMC’s potential move into AI memory at Nvidia’s request could materially reshape the supply chain for one of the industry’s most constrained components.

top5.title: Google DeepMind agents expose weaknesses in old encryption
top5.description: Google DeepMind agents have exposed weaknesses in older encryption methods, with a claimed speed 1,600 times faster.
top5.why: Google DeepMind’s claimed ability to expose weaknesses in older encryption highlights an emerging cybersecurity and post-quantum migration risk, even though the findings still require scrutiny.
